html:
SMTO-UI-0013 — SMTO couldn't save this conversation setting

GUID: 14eca777-531f-484c-a132-a94314403df9
Slug: ui-composer-field-invalid
Domain: UI · Subsystem: ui

What happened

  • A control under your message box tried to save a setting this page doesn't recognize. Nothing was saved, and your other conversation settings are unchanged.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Refresh the browser page. If SMTO was updated recently, close the tab and open SMTO again. This usually means part of the page is older than the rest and tried to save a setting that no longer exists.
  2. Open your conversation and change the setting again with the controls under the message box, such as Thinking or the Gateway picker. After refreshing, those controls only save settings SMTO supports.
  3. If the same control fails again, leave it as it is and send your message with the other settings. Your other settings weren't affected, so you can keep working while this is looked at.

What success looks like

  • The setting you changed stays in place after you refresh the page.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the name of the control you used, to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A composer profile patch included a key outside the supported composer fields list, so the browser rejected it before applying or saving anything.

What this means

  • A composer profile patch includes a key outside the explicitly supported fields list. The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • A composer profile patch includes a key outside the explicitly supported fields list.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare changed keys with the current composer fields rather than sending arbitrary profile data.

How to fix it

  • patch() in conversation_composer_profile.js rejects any key not in its fields list before merging or saving. Find which control sent the unsupported key (often a stale cached script after an update), reload the page to load matching assets, and edit only supported composer preferences.
  • Refresh the composer and edit only its supported preferences.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The patch contains only supported intentional composer preferences.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The shown control rejects this local action before its dependent submission. Earlier requests and saved state are unaffected by this validation result; server-side authority remains authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
